description: Canonical Telegram bot runtime parameters for the Cici instance. Security-critical settings (allowed_user_ids) must be changed via proposal.

allowed_user_ids.description: Comma-separated Telegram user IDs permitted to interact with Cici. Xavier must populate TELEGRAM_ALLOWED_USER_IDS in the environment. This field documents the policy; runtime enforcement reads from the env var.
allowed_user_ids.note: Xavier: set TELEGRAM_ALLOWED_USER_IDS=<your_telegram_user_id> in your .env file. Find your ID by messaging @userinfobot on Telegram.

delivery.owner_chat_id_note: Set TELEGRAM_OWNER_CHAT_ID to Xavier's personal chat ID. Used for digest delivery and system alerts. Find it by messaging @userinfobot.
delivery.mode_note: Use 'polling' for local development. Switch to 'webhook' for production by setting TELEGRAM_WEBHOOK_URL in env and updating this field via proposal.

rate_limits.description: If a user sends more than this many messages in 60 seconds, ignore additional messages until the window resets. Prevents abuse.

message_constraints.description: Telegram hard limit is 4096 chars. Cici splits responses at 4000 to leave headroom.

bot_commands.description: Registered command list. Update this via proposal when adding new commands.

commands.description: Resume or trigger the daily digest now
Show recent memories Cici has about you
Ask Cici to note something should not be remembered
